title: Intro — Oscillator into Gate into Mixer
outro: Built and playing — all from a script

steps.note: The Complex Oscillator, top left, is where sound begins. On its own it just drones.
A low pass gate is what turns that drone into plucks or drum beats.
It is a volume control and a tone control at once: struck, it opens briefly and shuts again, and the sound darkens as it closes — the way a real instrument does.
So take the oscillator's principal output into the gate's A input.
Then the gate's A output to the mixer. The mixer lives on its own page, so its inputs appear as buttons under the tab.
The gate has a clock of its own, which will strike it for us.
That is a patch: a source, something to shape it, and a way out to the speakers.
Now open the timbre. That is the wave folder — more harmonics the further it goes.
